''R6'' - TheBuilderMC |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = Yes |moveable = No |interactable = No |oldmusic = '''Version 1 & 3''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Power Dance|250px|thumb|center]] |newmusic = '''Version 2''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Whip Original|250px|thumb|center]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Power!|Store Description}} }} __TOC__ == Description == '''Power Dance''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|800}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/51636134/profile AltiWyre]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. == Trivia == *This [[Emotes|emote]] was based on the [https://knowyourmeme.com/editorials/in-the-media/the-halloween-classic-spooky-scary-skeletons-gets-a-challenging-tiktok-dance 2019 Spooky Scary Skeletons] trend on TikTok. *The current music that this emote uses was originally shared with the [[Breakdown]] emote. **The second version used was the same as the version 1 and 3 of the [[Whip]] emote music. == Update History == *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **'''Power Dance''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation changed. *'''22 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]e **Music removed. *'''7 June 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]]c **Music added. **{{Bug}} '''Power Dance''' plays the wrong music. **{{Bug}} '''Power Dance''' only plays music in the lobby. *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Power Dance''' now plays the correct music. **{{Bugfix}} '''Power Dance''' now plays music during matches. {{EmoteNavBox}}
